projects.description: An intelligent AI search assistant that reads through documents and answers complex questions instantly using smart vector retrieval.
An automated security scanner that analyzes incoming emails, detects sneaky phishing links and suspicious text patterns, and warns you before you fall for a scam.
A computer vision app that identifies and classifies different fruits from photos in real time by extracting deep visual patterns and running instant predictions.
A smart language tool that catches spelling errors in Gujarati text and suggests the correct words by analyzing letter sequences and calculating edit distances.
